entities.summary: Godfrey Mwampembwa, pen name Gado (1969) is a Tanzanian-born political cartoonist, animator and comics artist. He is the most syndicated political cartoonist in East and Central Africa, and for over two decades a contributor for Daily Nation (Kenya), The Standard (Kenya), New African , Courrier International (France) as well as for Business Day and Sunday Tribune. He also produced cartoons for The East African, Le Monde, The Washington Times, Der Standard and Japan Times.
